title: Claude Sonnet 5
content:
## Overview

Claude Sonnet 5 (model ID `claude-sonnet-5`) launched on **June 30, 2026** and became the new default model for Free and Pro users on Claude.ai the same day. Anthropic positions it as its most agentic Sonnet yet — built specifically to plan multi-step work, drive browsers and terminals, and run autonomously for longer stretches without human intervention.

---

## Key Specs

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Model ID | `claude-sonnet-5` |
| Context window | 1M tokens (default and maximum — no smaller-context variant) |
| Max output tokens | 128K |
| Thinking | Adaptive extended thinking |
| Launch pricing | $2 / $10 per Mtok (input/output) through August 31, 2026 |
| Standard pricing | $3 / $15 per Mtok after August 31, 2026 |

---

## Benchmarks

Sonnet 5 posts the largest generation-over-generation jump Anthropic has shipped in a Sonnet-tier model, particularly on coding and agentic tasks:

- **SWE-bench Verified:** 72.7% (up from Sonnet 4.6's 62.3%; Opus 4.8 sits at 79.4%)
- **SWE-bench Pro:** 63.2%
- **Terminal-bench:** 76.1% (up from Sonnet 4.6's 55.4% — a +20.7 point jump, the single largest gain across benchmarks)
- **OSWorld** (computer-use tasks): 81.2%

The gains are concentrated in software engineering and long-horizon agentic work rather than general knowledge benchmarks, consistent with Anthropic's stated focus for this release.

---

## What Changed From Sonnet 4.6

- **Context window** grew from 200K to a default/max of 1M tokens, removing the need to request extended-context access separately.
- **Agentic reliability**: improved planning and tool-use consistency across long sessions, reflected in the Terminal-bench and OSWorld jumps.
- **Adaptive thinking**: the model now scales its internal reasoning budget to task difficulty rather than using a fixed thinking-token allocation.
- **Claude Code default**: Sonnet 5 became the default model in Claude Code alongside the platform-wide Claude.ai rollout.

---

## Where It Fits in the Lineup

As of July 2026, Sonnet 5 sits in the current Claude generation alongside **Opus 4.8** (most capable, released May 28, 2026), **Haiku 4.5** (fastest/cheapest), and **Fable 5** (Anthropic's limited-availability Mythos-class flagship, restored to general availability July 1, 2026 after a temporary export-control suspension). See the [Claude Model History](claude-model-history) page for the full generational timeline.

---

## Practical Notes

- The 1M-token context window is available by default — no separate beta header or opt-in is required, unlike earlier long-context betas on Sonnet 4.x.
- Introductory pricing ($2/$10 per Mtok) is time-boxed to August 31, 2026; budget for the $3/$15 standard rate afterward.
- For agentic coding workloads specifically, Sonnet 5 is now the recommended default over Opus 4.8 for most tasks given its much lower cost and comparable Terminal-bench performance — reserve Opus for tasks that need the extra reasoning headroom.
